feature: Extract compare() utility to shared module
description: The compare() function that determines winners between two values is duplicated verbatim in useCompareDistricts.ts and useCompareParties.ts. Extract this to a shared utility.

phases.title: Create shared utility
phases.description: Create the compare utility and its types in the shared package

subtasks.title: Create compare utility file
subtasks.description: Create packages/shared/src/compare.ts with the compare function and CompareResult type exported. The function takes two nullable numbers and a higherIsBetter flag, returns {winnerA, winnerB, tie}.

subtasks.title: Export from shared index
subtasks.description: Update packages/shared/src/index.ts to export the compare function and CompareResult type from the new compare module.

subtasks.title: Add unit tests for compare utility
subtasks.description: Create packages/shared/src/compare.test.ts with comprehensive tests covering: both null values, one null value, equal values, A wins (higher is better), B wins (higher is better), A wins (lower is better), B wins (lower is better).

phases.title: Update consumers
phases.description: Update the hook files to use the shared compare utility instead of their local implementations

subtasks.title: Update useCompareDistricts.ts
subtasks.description: Import compare from 'shared' package and remove the local compare function definition (lines 24-42). Update the import statement at the top of the file.

subtasks.title: Update useCompareParties.ts
subtasks.description: Import compare from 'shared' package and remove the local compare function definition (lines 24-42). Update the import statement at the top of the file.

phases.title: Verification
phases.description: Run tests and verify the application builds correctly

subtasks.title: Run shared package tests
subtasks.description: Run bun test in packages/shared to verify the new compare utility tests pass.

subtasks.title: Run web app type check
subtasks.description: Run tsc --noEmit in apps/web to verify TypeScript compilation passes with the new imports.

subtasks.title: Run web app build
subtasks.description: Run the build command to ensure the application builds correctly with the refactored code.

risks.mitigation: The web app already imports from 'shared' for types, so the import path should work consistently

qa_checklist: No duplicate compare() function remains in useCompareDistricts.ts
No duplicate compare() function remains in useCompareParties.ts
